integrity: Proof is analytical. Finite numerical checks support but do not substitute for proof. No independent validation or independent priority certification was performed.
scientific_limitations: For fixed c away from the crossover c=pi the result determines eventual complete positivity, and proves negative eigenvalue asymptotics. The borderline c=pi, exact finite-n thresholds and arbitrary graphs remain open within this analysis. The inaccessible full text of Wood (1995) leaves a residual historical equivalence risk.
title: A sharp complete-positivity crossover for geodesic Gaussian Schur multipliers on cycles
